featured_reviews.name: Trish
featured_reviews.review_text:
Converse is pure GOLD! I’ve been in love with this brand for over a decade now, and honestly, words can’t fully do justice to how amazing it feels to wear these shoes. They’re incredibly comfortable, and Converse somehow keeps leveling up the style game too.

I had been waiting for a Converse store in Mumbai for the longest time, and a late-night random search finally proved me right. The store, located in the heart of Khar, is hard to miss. And not to be dramatic, but walking in genuinely felt like entering a candy store.

The space is neat, clean, compact, and thoughtfully laid out with just the right things in the right places. But more importantly, the people there are absolute gems.

I only made the trip because Yuri was kind enough to patiently respond to all my queries over text. And Gulzar — what an absolute pleasure it was interacting with you! His product knowledge, explanations, patience, and suggestions were spot on. I genuinely had the best time chatting about Converse and its history with him. In fact, the conversation was so enriching that I completely forgot to click photos of the store but I’ll definitely be back soon to upload the pair I picked up :)

Everything about the people, the store, and the brand makes the visit worth it. And of course… buy the shoes. The experience itself is priceless :)

featured_reviews.name: Suhana Khanna
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a wonderful experience at the Converse store thanks to Gulzar. From the moment I walked in, he was incredibly welcoming, attentive, and genuinely helpful. He took the time to understand what I was looking for and patiently showed me multiple options, offering thoughtful suggestions without being pushy.
What really stood out was his knowledge about the products and his willingness to go the extra mile to make sure I found exactly what I wanted. Gulzar made the entire shopping experience smooth, enjoyable, and completely stress-free.
It’s rare to come across customer service that feels this genuine and attentive. Gulzar’s professionalism, friendliness, and dedication truly reflect positively on the store. I would definitely look forward to visiting again because of the excellent service he provided.

I would strongly advise others to be cautious before placing an order here until there is a clear improvement in communication and reliability.
